_readme: Every application/game the hub knows about. id must be unique and never change (it is stored in home layouts and sessions). entry is relative to the project root. status: available | in-development | concept. requires lists devices the app needs: bike, heartRate, controller. ownHomeButton: true when the app draws its own way back to the hub (the hub then hides its floating home button over it). Art: every application folder has assets/app_icon.png (square or square-ish), used automatically; set cover to use another image. colors + glyph are shown while the art is missing.

applications.title: Party Spin
applications.subtitle: Spin together
applications.description: A spinning party for a group: one big screen, everyone rides, plays power-up cards on each other and answers Hakoot questions. Needs the Party Spin server (applications/PartySpin/server).

applications.title: 80s Highway
applications.subtitle: Free ride & workouts
applications.description: Free ride on your own slope and gears or at a target power, or ride structured workouts (or write your own) under a neon synthwave sun.
